author: simplified1554
text:
The product is not the model. It is the audit trail. Banks do not lose sleep over a pretty pitchbook. They lose sleep over a number that cannot be sourced when compliance calls.
Research draft: [✓] minutes Model build: [✓] fast Sign-off: [X] still human, still slow
If citations, data lineage, and template lock are real, this eats the first-year analyst stack. If they are marketing, it becomes another unapproved tab. Who on the desk is allowed to ship a client memo that the model wrote?

author: tim_maundu
text: @OpenAI The real value here is not “AI writes finance documents.” It is faster research loops, better scenario testing, cleaner client materials and fewer manual spreadsheet rituals. But finance AI has to show sources, assumptions and audit trail clearly.

author: ShaneaLeven
text: @OpenAI Finance is where accuracy, context, and auditability matter most. This is a serious test of how far agentic workflows can go.

author: HSJK33
text:
The singularity may be closer than we think.

As AI moves from answering questions to doing research, building models and preparing client work, white-collar jobs are entering a much tougher phase.

I don’t think every job disappears.

But the value of simply producing information is falling fast.

The premium will increasingly go to judgement, context, relationships, and knowing what questions are worth asking.
